device.description: 8-bit 280 kSPS 1.2-3.6 V micropower SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface and auto power-down
device.note: ads7866.pdf (SLAS465, ADS7866/ADS7867/ADS7868) p.8 electrical characteristics (VDD 1.2-3.6 V, VIH max 3.6 V, straight binary), p.9 timing requirements and Figure 1, p.10 pin configuration and terminal functions, p.19-20 digital interface (CPOL = 1, CPHA = 1, inputs up to 3.6 V) (4 leading zeros, straight binary), auto power-down

pages: p.8 (electrical characteristics), p.9 (timing requirements, Figure 1: tD(CSF-SDOVALID) 65 ns, tD(SCLKF-SDOVALID) 140 ns, tDIS(EOC-SDOZ) 80 ns at 1.2 V), p.10 (pins), p.19-20 (digital interface, Table 2)
notModeled: analog input; REF/VDD is both the supply and the reference (input range 0 V to VDD); the result is always the 0 V code
the conversion is clocked by SCLK (9 SCLK cycles after the 2-clock sample, 12 clocks per frame): not timed, the 0 V code is available at once

SPI mode 3 per p.19 (CPOL = 1, CPHA = 1: SDO changes on SCLK falling edges, read on rising edges); the first leading zero appears at CS falling and the other three on falling edges 1-3, MSB on the 4th (12-clock frame, 4 zeros + 8 data bits, then Hi-Z as at EOC)
auto power-down after each conversion, the conversion abort when CS rises before EOC and the power-on dummy cycle
throughput, SCLK frequency and tSU(CSF-FSCLKF) limits
variants: ADS7866, ADS7867, ADS7868 share ads7866.pdf (12/10/8-bit, same pinout and frame with 4 leading zeros; ADS7866, ADS7867: own spec files). ADS7886/87/88 are the 2.35-5.25 V versions (other datasheet).
